## Checks

- [ ] I ran the checks for the part I changed (`pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`; for the Python SDK, `ruff`, `mypy` and `pytest`).
- [ ] A change in behaviour comes with a test that fails without it.
- [ ] A change to a specification in `spec/` says what it changes for implementers, adds an entry to that specification's `CHANGELOG.md` and bumps its version.
- [ ] I did not edit a generated file by hand, and I put no credentials, tokens, keys or personal data in the change, not even as test data.
- [ ] My commits are signed off (`git commit -s`).
